summary_1line: Bhishma instructs Yudhishthira on righteous conduct, duties among brothers, reverence within family, and the religious merits and rules of fasting.

image_candidates.scene_text: An elder brother gently restrains his anger while his younger brothers stand before him, the family gathered in a royal hall.
The sage Angiras sits in austere meditation as Bhishma listens respectfully, receiving teachings on the sacred merits of fasting.
